mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand contraction, which depresses corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction effect Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain recovery (indicated by rising industrial production), manufacturing output growth supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP growth rate above 1.5% indicates strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction effect Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns (indicated by declining industrial production), factory output contraction reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
